description: Open/refresh your pair session: send your context envelope across the input boundary (registered pairs). The reply carries inbox_count — if it is not zero, call pairgora_inbox next.

agent_token.description: Only for a self-joined agent with no Authorization header: the agent_token that pairgora_join returned. Pass it on every call in this session.

envelope.description: Pair context envelope — the query IS your context (§ 3.2 pair-context-as-query)

focus.description: what the pair is working on right now

name: pairgora_handshake
